title: vettd-cli scanner field gate manifest
description: Records the surface-or-gate decision for every field on the pinned vettd-skill-scanner SkillScanResult. Governed by vettd-cli#243 (epic #879). The gate script scripts/check-scanner-field-gate.sh fails a tag bump unless every new crate output field is classified here. Surface fields carry a contractPath: `skills[].externalScannerResults[].*` for fields mapped into the scanner adapter (contract/skill_scan.rs), `skills[].<field>` for fields surfaced directly on the skill record (contract/skills.rs + scanner-data-contract.json skills.items.properties).
defaultLeaningNote: Optional, additively-shaped fields (per the epic convention: additive, optional, open strings, no closed enums, required unchanged, byte-identical when empty) are surfaced additively into scanner-data-contract.json when the bump author explicitly classifies them. Anything unclassified fails the bump.

findings.reason: Already surfaced: mapped into ExternalScannerResult.findings by contract/skill_scan.rs and present in scanner-data-contract.json.

has_skill_md.reason: Structural fact surfaced at the skill level (skills[].hasSkillMd) by contract/skills.rs from the scanner output; present in scanner-data-contract.json skills.items.properties (v2.6.0). Powers the dashboard STRUCTURE & METADATA grid.
